QuestInfo.name: Honor of the Dual Blades
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1056000##k, leader of #bThe Secret Garden#k, has something to tell you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1022000# wants you to represent the Dual Blades in #bBattle Mode#k. Aim for #bRank 9#k to bring honor to the Dual Blades. Talk to #b#p9070004##k in any city to join Battle Mode.
QuestInfo.2: #p1056000# was content to hear that you reached Rank 9. Achieve a higher rank to prove the true power of the Dual Blades.

0.0: Hello, #h0#. I realize how busy you must be, but I have a special task for you. I'm sure you have heard by now that #bBattle Mode#k has opened in Maple World.
0.1: Battle Mode... Where the strongest Maplers come to show off their abilities. I'm sure you can imagine the honor that a victory there would bring us.
0.2: We can't let this opportunity pass us by. We must prove the might of the Dual Blades in the arena. This is our chance to forge a new name for ourselves in Maple World.
0.3: #h0#, I want you to spearhead this effort. Join Battle Mode and reach #bRank 9#k so that none can look down upon us. You will do this, won't you?

yes.0: I expected no less. Now, go. You must speak with #b #p9070004# in any town#k to participate in Battle Mode.

no.0: Do the shadows really suit you so?

1.0: You reached Battle Mode Rank 9! Well done. Now no one will be able to look down upon the Dual Blades.

yes.0: Continue to fight for our honor in Battle Mode. I look forward to hearing of your exploits.

default.0: It looks like you haven't reached #bRank 9#k in #bBattle Mode#k yet. I know you have it in you. Go forth and show Maple World the strength of the Dual Blades. See #b#p9070004##k to reach Battle Square.
